_readme: Local market data for city x niche pages (Tier B: /locations/<city>/<niche>/).
WHY THIS EXISTS: without genuinely city-specific facts, every city page is the
same page with a find-and-replace, which is what Google's scaled-content-abuse
policy targets. A page is only allowed to be indexed once it carries real,
sourced local data.
HOW IT WORKS: this file is SPARSE. Only cities/niches you have actually
researched appear here. Anything missing, or with "verified": false, is
generated as noindex and excluded from the sitemap. Fill the data, flip
"verified": true, rebuild, and the page becomes indexable. That is the phased
rollout - start with ~20 pages, measure, then scale.
NEVER invent these numbers. They are published as fact and are checkable.
SOURCES (all free):
receptionist_salary  US: BLS OES, 'Receptionists and Information Clerks'
(43-4171) by metropolitan area -> annual mean wage.
EU: Eurostat earnings statistics / national stats office.
business_count       US: Census County Business Patterns, establishments by
NAICS code by metro (e.g. HVAC = NAICS 238220).
EU: Eurostat Structural Business Statistics.
licensing            State/national licensing board for that trade.
peak_season          NOAA / national climate data + trade seasonality.
PUBLISH THRESHOLD: see MIN_LOCAL_SIGNALS in region_config.py. A page needs
"verified": true plus at least that many populated fields to be indexed.

<city-slug>.gbp_presence: bool - true only where a real Google Business Profile / operation exists

<niche-id>.verified: bool - MUST be true for the page to be indexed
<niche-id>.source_note: string - where the figures came from, for your own audit trail
<niche-id>.business_count: int | null - establishments in this trade in the metro
<niche-id>.receptionist_salary: int | null - local annual loaded cost of the role AI replaces
<niche-id>.avg_job_value: int | null - typical job ticket for this trade locally
<niche-id>.seasonality_note: string | null - one sentence on local demand pattern
<niche-id>.licensing: string | null - local licensing requirement for this trade
<niche-id>.local_note: string | null - any other genuinely local detail
